integrity: Proof via an explicit Lyapunov kernel with uniformly verified algebraic positional classes. Symbolic and finite matrix tests supplement but do not replace the proof.
scientific_limitations: Strictly finite symmetric interval, projective two-sink monitoring, spatially uniform real two-state coin, strictly interior localized initial state, and angle between zero and pi/2; prior generating functions implicitly determine finite-time distributions, and independent novelty assessment remains open.
title: Exact absorption-time kernel for a two-wall coined quantum walk
